name: crawlforge-mcp-server
description: Web scraping, crawling, deep research and autonomous extraction — 30 MCP tools returning clean Markdown and structured JSON.
long_description:
CrawlForge turns any web page into clean Markdown or structured JSON. It bundles 30 tools: a unified multi-format `scrape`, batch scraping, deep crawling and site mapping, an autonomous `agent` that researches from a plain-English prompt, stealth browsing for bot-protected sites, pre-built site templates, change tracking, and llms.txt generation. LLM-backed extraction defaults to a local Ollama model, so no third-party AI key is required; OpenAI and Anthropic are opt-in.

Requires a free CrawlForge API key from https://www.crawlforge.dev — tool calls are metered in credits against that account.
